results.title: Closest conjugate
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $K$ be a normed field with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$, and let $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ be the spectral norm on $\overline{K}$ over $K$. For $\alpha, \beta \in \overline{K}$, $\alpha$ is the closest conjugate to $\beta$ if $\lVert \beta - \alpha \rVert < \lVert \beta - \sigma(\alpha) \rVert$ for every $K$-algebra automorphism $\sigma$ of $\overline{K}$ with $\sigma(\alpha) \ne \alpha$.

results.title: Closest conjugates satisfy Krasner's hypothesis
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a complete nontrivially normed field whose norm is ultrametric, with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$, let $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ be the spectral norm on $\overline{K}$ over $K$, and let $\alpha, \beta, \alpha' \in \overline{K}$. If $\alpha$ is the closest conjugate to $\beta$ and $\alpha' \ne \alpha$ is a conjugate of $\alpha$ over $K$, then $\lVert \alpha - \beta \rVert < \lVert \alpha - \alpha' \rVert$.

results.title: Krasner's lemma for closest conjugates

results.summary: Let $K$ be a complete nontrivially normed field whose norm is ultrametric, with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$, and let $\alpha, \beta \in \overline{K}$. If $\alpha$ is the closest conjugate to $\beta$ and $\alpha$ is separable over $K$, then $K(\alpha) \subseteq K(\beta)$.
